name: MuesliSwap
description: One of the earliest Cardano DEXs, operating a hybrid on-chain orderbook and AMM model. Trades ADA against a broad set of Cardano native tokens.
notes: Added as the first community-registry PR, which doubles as the live test of the taxonomy PR validation workflow. Asset list is directional (ADA plus the MILK protocol token); MuesliSwap lists many more pairs than recorded here.
